title: Cache Control Input
description: Stops cache headers from leaking or stranding content by reading back who stores the response and for how long (browser, CDN via CDN-Cache-Control or Surrogate-Control, other shared caches) and flagging per-user pages a CDN can cache, a cookie-setting response made public, no-cache mistaken for no-store, immutable on URLs that keep their name, a missing Vary for compressed or negotiated bodies and HTML kept for days, each with a one-tap fix.
stops: Private page cached by the CDN
